title: stajichlab/RelocaTE3 pipeline parameters
description: Transposable element insertion detection from resequencing data. Each step runs one relocaTE3 subcommand with the arguments relocaTE3 run-all passes.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Sample sheet, shared reference inputs and where results are written.
input_output_options.help_text: The sample sheet lists one row per sample (or per lane: rows sharing a sample name are merged). The genome, TE library and RepeatMasker annotation are shared by all samples.

input.help_text: Relative read paths in the sheet are resolved against the directory Nextflow is launched from, not the sheet's own directory.

repeatmasker.help_text: Filters novel calls that land on a known reference TE, and additionally emits the reference insertion calls (find-reference).

outdir.description: Output directory; each sample is written to <outdir>/<sample>.

calling_options.title: Calling options
calling_options.description: TE search, genome placement and insertion calling. Same names and defaults as relocaTE3 run-all.
calling_options.help_text: Defaults reproduce RelocaTE2. Each option maps to the run-all flag named in its description.

genome_aligner.description: Aligner for genome re-alignment (--genome-aligner). blat is not supported here.

te_opts.description: Extra options passed verbatim to the TE-search aligner (--te-opts), e.g. "-minIdentity=80" for blat.

genome_opts.description: Extra options passed verbatim to the genome aligner (--genome-opts), e.g. "-n 0.10" for bwa aln.

mismatch.description: Allowed mismatches, TE alignment and read/genome comparison (--mismatch).

min_match.description: Minimum alignment match length to the TE (--min-match).

min_trimmed.description: Minimum trimmed flanking sequence length to retain (--min-trimmed).

size.description: Library insert size for mate-pair-only insertions (--size).

min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ for a read to be admitted as evidence (--min-mapq). 0 = no gate.

tsd.description: TSD mode (--tsd). Only UNK is supported: each TSD is inferred from the reads, as RelocaTE2 does.
tsd.errorMessage: only --tsd UNK is supported: RelocaTE2 always infers each TSD from the reads, so a fixed TSD motif has no RelocaTE2 behavior to match.

require_both_junctions.description: Require junction reads on both sides of an insertion (--require-both-junctions).
require_both_junctions.help_text: Set to false to also emit single-sided calls (--no-require-both-junctions): more sensitive, much less precise on multi-family TE libraries.

target.errorMessage: --target must be ALL or a contig name made of [A-Za-z0-9._-] (it becomes part of file names and commands)

distance.description: Reference-TE boundary window for dropping one-sided calls (--distance).

te_name.errorMessage: --te_name must start with a letter or digit and contain only [A-Za-z0-9._-] (it becomes part of file names and commands)
te_name.description: TE label used in output file names (--te-name).

genotyping_options.title: Genotyping options
genotyping_options.description: Classify each insertion as homozygous, heterozygous or somatic.
genotyping_options.help_text: On by default in the pipeline (opt-in with --genotype for run-all), so the cohort genotype matrix is filled. A sample's genotype_bam column reuses an existing alignment instead of realigning its reads.

excision.description: Also search for excision events that leave a footprint (--excision).

profile_options.title: Profile options
profile_options.help_text: The pixi profile runs tasks without a container, with this environment's bin/ first on PATH.

pixi_env.description: Pixi environment providing relocaTE3 and the aligners (pixi profile). Default: <projectDir>/.pixi/envs/blat.
